cd /tmp && cat > crc64.py <<'PY'
POLY = 0xad93d23594c935a9
tab = []
for i in range(256):
    crc = i
    for _ in range(8):
        crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (POLY if crc & 1 else 0)
    tab.append(crc)
def crc64(crc, data):
    for b in data:
        crc = tab[(crc ^ b) & 0xff] ^ (crc >> 8)
    return crc

def crc64(data):
    poly=0x95ac9329ac4bc9b5; tab=[]
    for i in range(256):
